observations: Photo 0 shows the top of a white projector wrapped in plastic, with 'HITACHI' and 'CP-X3021WN' clearly visible.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same projector, with the same branding and model number visible.
Photo 2 shows the back of the projector, held by a hand, revealing multiple ports including HDMI, VGA, and audio jacks, still wrapped in plastic.
All photos show the projector covered in plastic wrap, suggesting it is new or unused.
The watermark 'SAMTECH PROJECTORS POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.
In the background of photo 2, two Epson projectors are visible on a shelf.

claims.claim: The XGA-resolution (1024 x 768) Hitachi CP-X3021WN Portable Projector has 3200 ANSI Lumens
claims.evidence: The resolution and lumens are not visible in any photo; they are stated by the seller. The model name is confirmed, but performance specs cannot be verified from images alone.

risks.risk: The projector may be non-functional or have a dead lamp or internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the projector powered on, projecting an image, and cycling through inputs.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may be a sign of a refurbished or used unit repackaged to appear new.
risks.proof: A close-up of the plastic wrap showing signs of previous removal or resealing, or a serial number check against manufacturer records.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cable, remote, or user manual.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the projector.

proof_requests: Video of the projector turned on and projecting an image.
Photo of the included accessories (power cable, remote, manual, etc.).
Close-up of the plastic wrap to check for signs of reuse or tampering.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified, but critical claims about performance (lumens, resolution) and condition (new vs. used) cannot be verified from the photos. The projector is wrapped, but this does not confirm it is new or functional. Proof of operation and included accessories is needed before pricing.
